messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: p95 latency > 1200ms in region-eu, smart-fallback policy triggered redispatch. Alert level: P2. Thread created: 2198765432

mike_oncall: ack @incident-bot I'm on it. Paging SRE and routing owners. @sarah_sre @raj_eng :phone:

sarah_sre: Joining. Seeing repeated redispatch decisions in the routing logs, looks like policy flipped region -> variant -> region. Possible fallback chose an incompatible variant in us-central causing cold KV cache and high start latency.

raj_eng: I've pulled the routing decisions, snippet below:
```
[2198765432] decision: route -> region-eu
[2198765440] fallback -> region-us, variant v1-int8
[2198765452] variant missing KV cache -> coldstart high-latency
[2198765460] auto-redispatch -> region-eu
```
This loop is creating p95 spikes and a lot of churn.

mike_oncall: Customer impact: several enterprise tenants reporting timeouts and elevated latencies (CS ticket #5721). We should stop automatic redispatch while we stabilize. @emma_support liaise with customers and share ETA.

emma_support: On it. I'll notify account teams and send an initial message: ETA ~30m, apologies, we're applying a temporary routing lock. Will update ticket owners. :white_check_mark:

sarah_sre: Mitigation plan (short): 1) disable smart-fallback auto-redispatch; 2) pin traffic to region-eu stable pool; 3) increase fallback-hold to 3m; 4) pin model variant to v2-fp16 (warmed). I'm going to apply the first two now.

raj_eng: Commands I will execute (approvals from oncall):
```bash
# disable auto redispatch
redwoodctl routing update --policy smart-fallback --auto-redispatch=false
# pin traffic to stable EU pool
redwoodctl route set --route-id rr-eu-stable --force
# pin model variant (non-disruptive pinning)
redwoodctl model pin --model-id text-xlarge --variant v2-fp16
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-policy-update by sarah_sre. Changes will roll out in ~30s. :rocket:

sarah_sre: Applied disable, verifying... seeing routing decisions stabilize. p95 trending down from ~1400ms -> ~650ms over the last 2 minutes. Still monitoring live metrics.

mike_oncall: Great. I'll suppress noisy alerts for now and leave manual paging. @lia_cs can you draft an RCA skeleton and timeline here? We'll use this thread as the live timeline.

lia_cs: On it. Current root cause hypothesis: fallback policy prefers lowest-latency region but doesn't account for variant compatibility/warmth. Fallback picked v1-int8 in us-central which had no warmed KV cache -> coldstart latency -> triggered p95 SLO -> system retried/redispatched back to eu, repeat.

raj_eng: Open question for product: should the fallback policy prefer variant compatibility and warmed-state over raw regional latency? My temporary proposal: add a compatibility weight and require warmed KV or a warmup probe before routing to a fallback variant.

sarah_sre: Agreed. Short-term fix: increase the hold-window to 180s so we avoid thrash while we design a better policy. Running command now:
```
redwoodctl routing update --policy smart-fallback --hold-window=180s
```

emma_support: CS update sent to affected accounts. No new error reports in the last 5 minutes from impacted tenants. Keeping watching for regressions.

mike_oncall: Switching ops to manual reroutes only. @raj_eng you're primary for the next 45 minutes; I'm handing off to you. Please escalate to engineering if anything flares.

raj_eng: Taking over. I'll produce follow-ups: (a) enforce model-variant compatibility checks in fallback policy; (b) add pre-warm/kv-prefetch for fallback variants; (c) add variant-level p95 and warm-state to observability dashboards. I'll own the action items and timeline.

sarah_sre: Filing incident in tracker: INF-1623, adding runbook updates and checklist (disable auto-redispatch, hold-window, model-pin). Leaving notes and links in the ticket. Closing paging for now.

incident-bot: Paging cleared. Incident status: P2 -> stabilized. Next scheduled update in +30m. Incident ticket: https://internal.redwood/incident/INF-1623
